buildings-combined.basis: Building value — assumed at the Fire and Allied Perils rate; confirm with broker

fire.basis: Plant, stock and contents (Fire and Allied Perils)

business-interruption.basis: Gross profit — 12 to 24 month indemnity; shorter periods: 25% of the Fire rate

office-contents.basis: Contents value — forcible/violent-entry theft extension rated at 5%

accounts-receivable.basis: Debtors outstanding — placeholder; awaiting broker rate

fidelity.basis: Limit of indemnity — placeholder; broker rates on sum insured and employee count

theft.basis: Stock at risk, typically a first-loss limit (sheet range 8–10%)

group-personal-accident.basis: Aggregate benefit — placeholder; awaiting broker rate

motor.basis: Fleet value — placeholder; broker rates vary by sum insured

motor-traders.basis: Vehicles in custody — placeholder; awaiting broker rate

public-liability.basis: Limit of indemnity — R83.33 per R1 000 000 (Public and Employees Liability)

broadform-liability.basis: Limit of indemnity — placeholder; sheet rates Public and Employees Liability together

umbrella-liability.basis: Limit of indemnity — placeholder; awaiting broker rate
